# Examples

Below are some things people have made with heightmaps from this tool.

## Sledders backcountry maps by DeNard420

Three of the four most downloaded maps for the snowmobile game [Sledders](https://mod.io/g/sledders) (built in Unity) were made by **DeNard420**, and all of them start from terrain made with this tool. Together they have been downloaded more than 400,000 times on mod.io.

The process: find a real place worth riding, export a DEM of it here, then work it up in tools like Gaea, adding rocks, trees, a labelled topo map, and props such as cabins and power lines. The tree maps come from Kris Tapio (Tapios\_BackCountry\_Builds), who traces the real tree lines from high-resolution satellite imagery, so the trees in the game sit almost exactly where they do in real life, with realistic density and tree lines.

-   [Whistler, British Columbia](https://mod.io/g/sledders/m/whistler): big chutes and peaks, trails, roads and rivers cleared
-   [Jackson Hole, Wyoming](https://mod.io/g/sledders/m/jackson-hole2): close to 1:1 on the lower peaks
-   [Aspen, Colorado](https://mod.io/g/sledders/m/aspen-snowmass): jump lines, named chutes and ski runs
-   [Mount Rainier, Washington](https://mod.io/g/sledders/m/mt-rainier): glaciers, crevasses and a detailed topo map
